# Vendored: doctest

Snapshot of **doctest**, a single-header C++ test framework (used by the native
test suite).

- Upstream: <https://github.com/doctest/doctest>
- Version: **v2.5.2** (2025-04-14)
- License: MIT (see [`LICENSE.txt`](LICENSE.txt))

Vendored as the single header `doctest.h` (upstream `doctest/doctest.h`).

## Local patches

None — pristine upstream.

## Updating

Copy `doctest/doctest.h` and `LICENSE.txt` from the new tag over this directory.
